title: HB 2143 (2025-2026 biennium (2025 Regular Session)): HB 2143 Requiring the secretary of state to enter into agreements with credit rating agencies for the release of certain information that can be used to verify the citizenship of persons registered to vote in this state.
operative_text:

(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec. 1: reinstatement on proof of citizenship
(quote) The county election officer shall notify any person who is removed from the voter registration rolls that such person may be reinstated on the voter registration rolls by providing proof of such person's United States citizenship.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1
(quote) The secretary of state shall enter into agreements with one or more credit rating agencies for the release of information held by such credit rating agency concerning residents of this state. Such information shall include, but is not limited to, names, addresses, phone numbers, social security numbers, dates of birth and alien registration numbers. The secretary shall use such information to verify the United States citizenship of persons who are registered to vote in this state.
(other) None beyond Sec. 1 and the effective-date clause.
